project.name: Project root / VS Code
project.target: An explicit local project root, with or without Git
project.persistence: Files in the selected project's .SYSTEMX folder
project.lowercaseAlias: Optional local filesystem link only; never a separate project directory

directory.name: Operating-system directory
directory.target: A user-selected Windows, macOS, or Linux working directory
directory.lowercaseAlias: Optional local filesystem link only; never a separate project directory

drive.name: Google Drive folder
drive.target: A locally available Drive for desktop project folder
drive.persistence: Regular files synchronized by Drive; one writer at a time
drive.lowercaseAlias: Optional local filesystem link only; never a separate project directory

chat.name: LLM chat
chat.target: A local project folder used to prepare a reviewable chat packet
chat.persistence: Explicit file changes or exports; chat alone does not persist records
chat.lowercaseAlias: Optional local filesystem link only; never a separate project directory
